summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by GSK plc reporting the vesting of a 2023 Performance Share Plan award for the Chief Financial Officer, Julie Brown, on April 27, 2026. The award vested at 82% with 18% lapsing, and 243,880 shares were issued at a zero exercise price. The closing price on vesting was £20.16. These are routine director/PDMR share dealings and do not represent a special situation.
